functions.recoveredRole: Selects all content in the Add Curve advanced editor.
functions.behavior: Passes AdvancedEdit to the shared SynEdit select-all routine, which moves the caret to the calculated end of the buffer and selects from line 1, column 1 through that endpoint. Empty content produces an empty selection at line 1, column 1.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds AddCurveDlg.pmMain.mnSelectAll.OnClick to address 013d0590. The handler reads form field 0x848 and calls FUN_00bfa390. AdvancedEditMouseDown independently identifies field 0x848 as AdvancedEdit. FUN_00bfa390 builds the range from 1:1 through the last line length plus one, and the sibling Copy handler calls it before clipboard copying.
